scope: Corrected SUBSET_SAMPLING path only; other reliability algorithms are unchanged and are not certified by this envelope.

observedBenchmark.timingScope: Single measured analysis duration; excludes compilation, validation and container startup, not a performance guarantee.

resourceModel.complexity: L*N model calls; O(L*N*d) proposals, O(L*N*log(N)) threshold sorting, O(L*N/10*45) chain-correlation products; O(N*(d+1)) working sample storage
resourceModel.formula: effective_evaluation_limit = N * min(10, floor(requested_budget / N)); 100 <= N <= 5000 in multiples of 10, requested_budget <= 50000, d <= 20
resourceModel.unit: top-level original-model point invocations, excluding preflight validation and user-model internal subcomputations
resourceModel.upstreamDerivation: SubsetSampling.run evaluates N points initially and generatePoints evaluates N per conditional population; maximumOuterSampling is per population, not global. The guard checks before each model invocation. At conditional probability 0.1, Nc=N/10 and chain length 10; computeVarianceGamma nests lag, seed and pair loops, performing Nc*(9+8+...+1)=45*Nc products per conditional population. KeepSample is disabled; an opaque model call is subject to the Sandbox hard deadline.

auditAnswers.hiddenLoopNesting: Adaptive populations multiply the per-population sample count. The covariance diagnostic also nests lag, seed and paired positions, enumerated independently in the test. Target CoV does not control subset termination.
auditAnswers.maximumConfiguration: N=5000, total budget 50000, d=20 permit ten populations and 50000 calls, 105000 working sample values and 202500 indicator-pair products over nine conditional populations. Budgets 50001 and the legacy schema maximum 2000000 reject before sampling. Output is at most ten rows and 16384 payload bytes.
auditAnswers.uiMaximumDimension: At d=20 the UI default N=2000 and budget=20000 permit at most ten populations and 20000 calls. The fixed-seed four-sigma core benchmark completes five populations and exactly 10000 calls; the browser asserts the submitted configuration.

interpretationBoundaries: Only a completed final threshold estimates the requested event; intermediate-domain or interrupted estimates are not published as successful results.
The nominal 95% Normal interval is approximate and may be optimistic from between-level dependence and finite-sample bias; it is not an exact confidence guarantee.
Threshold completion does not prove mixing, causal validity or predictive validity beyond the specified input distribution.
